title: The homies of Pivoland
body:
# WELOCME TO THE HOMIES OF PIVOLAND PAGE ♥ [EN]
![2d totems](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/08c906f676cff95c18294d3193f4004f4b8c8aa8.png)

This resource pack is intended for players of the Pivoland and The Homies servers. It primarily contains the totems used by players on these servers, as well as some CIT items

This resourcepack requiered [CIT RESEWN](https://modrinth.com/mod/cit-resewn) & [https://modrinth.com/mod/entity-model-features/versions](https://modrinth.com/mod/entity-model-features/versions) [https://modrinth.com/mod/entitytexturefeatures](https://modrinth.com/mod/entitytexturefeatures)
and optional [RP RENAMES](https://modrinth.com/mod/rp-renames) 


# ПРИВЕТСТВУЮ НА THE HOMIES OF PIVOLAND ♥ [RU]
![3d totems](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d85756b4a7846d8d80e6f2a974be96666bdd1ad6.png)
Этот ресурспак предназначен для игры игроками серверов Pivoland и The Homies. Он содержит по большей части тотемы игроков, которые на них играют, а также немного CIT предметов

Ресурспак требует [CIT RESEWN](https://modrinth.com/mod/cit-resewn) & [https://modrinth.com/mod/entity-model-features/versions](https://modrinth.com/mod/entity-model-features/versions) [https://modrinth.com/mod/entitytexturefeatures](https://modrinth.com/mod/entitytexturefeatures)
и опционально [RP RENAMES](https://modrinth.com/mod/rp-renames)
